name: ILLUSTRATIVE: International private medical insurance (expat)
summary: Illustrative rules: people living outside their home country, aged up to 74 at enrolment, with pre-existing conditions declared and excluded.

eligibility.nationality_note: Any nationality, but the member must live outside their country of nationality.
eligibility.timeline_note: Short-term plans run 3 to 11 months; annual plans run 12 months.

required_documents.label: Passport
required_documents.why: Shows nationality, which must differ from the country of residence.
required_documents.fix: Upload the photo page of a valid passport.

required_documents.label: Proof of residence abroad (visa, residence permit, lease or employment contract)
required_documents.why: The plan covers people living outside their home country.
required_documents.fix: Upload a visa, residence permit, lease, or employment contract in the country of residence.

required_documents.label: Medical history declaration
required_documents.why: Pre-existing conditions must be declared; they are usually excluded.
required_documents.fix: Complete and upload the medical history declaration, listing every existing condition.
